doc: Event script for map s19, the Shingala story location tied to Pau's house. It plays events 408 (the Moon of Destruction murals and Shingala, controlled by a head device, attacking), 410 (the party withdraws), 416 (Monica tells Max to put the Electric Fish in Shingala's mouth, then the boss fight with monster 516) and 420 (the device switches off and Shingala is brought back to the water). Killing Shingala leads to a special game over. Floor change prompts load the d04 dungeon script.
